requests.question: Which object classes may originate the section-to-run-to-net click ladder?
requests.recommended_response: Approve track and wire sections exclusively; all other net-member clicks remain object-only.

requests.question: How do component-owned graphics behave in the board workspace?
requests.recommended_response: Approve current behavior: sub-graphics select the parent component and component Edge.Cuts graphics have no hit region.

requests.question: Are owned user and fabrication text independently selectable in definition editors?
requests.recommended_response: Approve independent selection with the same strict-majority oriented-layout rule as reference/value text.

requests.question: What region and composition rules govern pads and pins in definition editors?
requests.recommended_response: Approve center-anchor qualification for pads, connection-anchor qualification for the complete pin subject, and pad geometry plus pad-number text as one subject.

requests.question: Are owned graphics independent authored targets in Footprint and Symbol Editors?
requests.recommended_response: Approve extending the generic path and filled-graphic rules to definition-editor owned graphics.

requests.question: How does a selected library definition relate to its placed instances?
requests.recommended_response: Approve merely-related projection with exact authored appearance and no selection accent; never treat definition and instance as the same identity.

requests.question: Is a junction dot an owned member of a Global Net selection?
requests.recommended_response: Approve inclusion because the junction is resolved conductive geometry.

requests.question: What region and hierarchy-projection rules govern buses?
requests.recommended_response: Approve the generic path rule for spine and entries and Global-Net-style hierarchy projection with bus-distinct typing.

requests.question: Which common fields does compound schematic text expose?
requests.recommended_response: Approve the PCB text field set where typed: style, height, stroke, alignment, and visibility.

requests.question: Should board dimensions enter S5A despite having no scene projection?
requests.recommended_response: Defer dimensions from S5A until typed scene projection exists; do not ratify unimplementable acquisition rules now.

requests.question: Should hierarchical sheet representations enter S5A despite being untyped and unhittable?
requests.recommended_response: Defer sheet-body selection from S5A until typed sheet and sheet-pin scene authority exists.

requests.question: What S5A acquisition scope applies to proposal, review, and diagnostic subjects?
requests.recommended_response: Keep existing explicit action/lane selection, exclude non-authored subjects from region and Ctrl+A acquisition, and defer mixed compound semantics until each channel has complete typed scene authority.

requests.question: How do field visibility and definition-child locking relate to canvas visibility and lock semantics?
requests.recommended_response: Treat field visibility as a typed property distinct from layer hiding; invisible fields are not canvas-acquirable, and definition children remain without lock authority until S5B types it.

requests.question: How does dense/tiny fallback apply when selection overlays proposal, review, or diagnostic channels?
requests.recommended_response: Apply the same deterministic selection-cue cap and whole-pane union-mask fallback after preserving each channel's semantic shape, severity, and proposal/review identity.
